data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's claim that distinguishing genuine reliability from compliance is circular because constructing adversarial items requires the evaluators to possess the causal knowledge the checklist encodes is too strong and ignores a valid non-circular source. The target itself admits in its first countercondition that evaluators can construct adversarial items from a NOVEL, INDEPENDENT causal model not used to create the checklist. This admitted case breaks the self-referential loop, yet the main claim asserts necessity of circularity without qualification, contradicting its own countercondition.
